violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Internal condensate shelf of ice machine is not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. PIC removed ice from machine and washed, rinsed, and sanitized all internal surfaces.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a dump sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. Employee instructed to wash hands in designated hand sink, where there is soap and paper towels.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: mixed salad greens stored on counter (71F), kale tonic juice x2 (45F and 48F) on counter, pancake batter in unit 5 (56F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Aforementioned foods discarded. All food items observed stored on counter to now be stored under direct refrigeration or in ice baths.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Design
violations.observation: Insect control device does not retain the insects within the device. An electric fly swatter/zapper observed onsite.
violations.corrective_action: If insect control devices electrocute or stun insects, the device shall be designed to catch and hold the insects. Staff instructed to not use fly zapper and to remove from establishment.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: door to outdoor seating is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means.
violations.corrective_action: Door is to remain closed unless provided with a screen (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Door was closed by the PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: crockpot used to hot hold blueberry compote
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PIC at time of pre-occupancy inspection was instructed to remove the piece of equipment. CFM at first routine inspection also instructed to remove the piece of equipment.
